facts.fact: The CNDP stated that AI processing of personal data is governed by Law 09-08, and that automatic decisions need attention so citizens keep access to redress.
The CNDP stated that one of its missions is to ensure that AI processing of personal data complies with Law 09-08.

MAR.note: No government use of an AI system is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.

facts.fact: The CNDP says it was created by Dahir 1-09-15 of 18 February 2009 promulgating Law 09-08, and that it is carrying out its mission of checking compliance, including work on a deliberation on AI processing.

The CNDP states that Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals regarding personal data processing, promulgated by Dahir 1-09-15 of 18 February 2009 (BO 5714 of 5 March 2009), governs AI processing of personal data.
The CNDP, created by the Dahir promulgating Law 09-08, says it supervises compliance of data processing, including AI, with that law.
